criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Assesses fit to the requested workload, users, systems, and operating requirements.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named capacity, architecture, supported integrations, tested connectors, performance limits, and requirements not met.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Assesses whether the supplier has a resourced and testable delivery plan.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named delivery owners, timeline, milestones, migration rehearsals, acceptance criteria, training, dependencies, and rollback.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Assesses price transparency and total cost over the stated contract term.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Contract term total, included services, exclusions, variable charges, assumptions, price changes, and optional costs. Do not reward low price alone.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Assesses evidenced safeguards and transparent disclosure of security limitations.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Encryption, access control, incident notice, independent audit evidence, report scope and date, and identified control gaps.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Assesses support availability and relevant delivery experience.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Support hours, priority response target, escalation, recovery objectives, comparable deployments, and support limitations.

criteria.name: Service Levels & Availability
criteria.description: Strength and enforceability of service levels.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Uptime target, measurement window, service credits, escalation.

criteria.name: API & Integration Depth
criteria.description: Fit with required systems and integration patterns.

criteria.name: Data Residency & Privacy
criteria.description: Location, handling, retention, and access controls for data.

criteria.name: Exit & Portability
criteria.description: Ability to export data and transition at contract end.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Formats, fees, transition assistance, deletion proof.

criteria.name: Security Certification
criteria.what_to_inspect: ISO 27001 or SOC 2 scope and validity.
